subject: Sanae Takaichi
claim: is the current Prime Minister of Japan
ground_truth: Shigeru Ishiba announced his resignation in September 2025. Sanae Takaichi won the LDP leadership election and was sworn in as Prime Minister of Japan on 21 October 2025, the first woman to hold the post. Fumio Kishida left office in 2024 and is not the current PM.
